description: This pie chart depicts the distribution of 1,100 tasks across nine categories related to language model capabilities. The chart is divided into nine slices, with labels radiating outward from a central point. The slices represent, in clockwise order starting from the top: Triggering (light blue, approximately 10%), Dynamic Environment (blue, approximately 9%), Memorization (dark blue, approximately 9%), Dynamic Instruction (blue, approximately 9%), Multitasking (green, approximately 16%), Privacy Protection (green, approximately 11%), Contradiction Resolution (red, approximately 10%), Context Tracking (dark blue, approximately 10%), and Context Retrieving (dark green, approximately 10%). Numerical values are provided alongside each label, ranging from 100 to 160. The chart includes a legend labeling each category and its corresponding color. The slices are not visually emphasized or ordered in any apparent manner beyond their arrangement around the center.
caption_used: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of 1.1K tasks across three primary categories and nine subcategories, with balanced sample sizes across capabilities. The central categories include 'Context Retrieving' (dark green), 'Context Tracking' (dark blue), and 'Contradiction Resolution' (dark red). Among the subcategories, 'Multitasking' has the highest value at 180, followed by 'Privacy Protection' at 121. Notably, 'Recursive Reasoning' demonstrates a consistent upward trend in its value compared to other subcategories. The chart provides a clear visual representation of the relative importance of each capability, with 'Dynamic Instruction' and 'Memorization' showing the lowest values at 90 each, indicating their lesser emphasis in the dataset.
